newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Copper seen probing overhead levels.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Copper seen probing overhead levels.

text.p: 3 MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
---------------VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - April 16----------------
Copper was likely to probe the top of its range after Tuesday's positive performance, but may end up consolidating between $2,250 and $2,300, traders and analysts said.
Aluminium needs to surmount resistance at $1,560/65 to resume its uptrend.
COPPER -
Stabs at the upside were likely, but the market was still wary of players selling into rallies.
"Copper closed at 7 p.m. above Monday's high at $2,280/82, suggesting a test of $2,290 and important resistance at $2,315," said chartist Harry Creates of broker AMT.
During Tuesday's gains, copper broke back above its 100-day moving average at $2,260, which should now offer support.
Further support was around $2,250, just above Monday's lows, $2,220 and $2,200, analysts said.
"The key issue is whether the funds are now looking to sell rallies in the base metals or are just happy having squared their positions," said broker GNI.
On the upside, the 10-day moving average at $2,303 should create a sticky area.
"If we can get break above $2,320, it should run up to $2,380," said analyst Jeremy Bodkin of broker Billiton.
At 0830 GMT three months LME copper was quoted at $2,280/82, unchanged from Tuesday's late close.
ALUMINIUM -
The market held a tight range on Tuesday just above $1,550 and now lacks impetus.
"The direction from here is difficult to peg, although it is most likely overall to trade within the range $1,530/35 to $1,565/70," said broker Gerald.
If prices broke to the downside a key area to watch is the $1,534 February low, which was the weakest of the year.
If that was violated, prices would slide to $1,500 and may try to fill a gap from last November from around $1,570 to $1,580, Bodkin said.
"Ideally, I would like to see it above $1,560/65 because that would put it back inside the uptrend," he added.
At 0830 GMT three months aluminium was quoted at $1,555/58, up $2/$4 from Tuesday's late close.
--Eric Onstad, London Newsroom +44 171 542-8065
